explanation: Compared against OEIS A230507, conjecture (ii): 'Any integer n > 8 can be written as x + y + z (x, y, z > 0) with 2x+1, 2y+1, 2z−1, 2x⁴−1, 2y⁴−1, 2z⁴−1 all prime.' The Lean statement reproduces this exactly, including the asymmetric 2z − 1; the natural subtractions are exact for positive x, y, z. Faithful.
